FVTK.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
FVTK.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log Foundry VTT Toolkit activity to the browser console.
FVTK.Import.Title: Build campaign from NotebookLM
FVTK.Import.Instructions: Paste the ##ENTRY blocks from NotebookLM, or choose the file you collected them in. The toolkit checks the campaign, generates missing scene images, builds the journals, items, NPCs, playlists and scenes in the NotebookLM compendiums, adds them to the world from there, sets up the scenes, and picks YouTube tracks. The preview shows what each entry becomes before anything changes.
FVTK.Import.File: …or choose a file exported from NotebookLM (.md or .txt):
FVTK.Import.ImageFolder: Scene image folder. Locations and scenes whose name matches an image file, e.g. the-overlook.jpg, also become Foundry scenes; generated images are saved here (default: the world's assets/notebooklm folder):
FVTK.Import.ImageFolderError: Could not read the scene image folder {folder}, so no images already in it will be used.
FVTK.Import.Overwrite: Replace journals, items, NPCs, scenes and playlists that already exist with the same name (picked YouTube tracks are kept)
FVTK.Import.GMOnly: Only a GM can import from NotebookLM.
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Name: YouTube Data API key (GM)
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Hint: Used by the YouTube track picker to search. Stored only in this browser, never sent to players. Create one in Google Cloud Console (YouTube Data API v3) and restrict it to this site.
FVTK.YouTube.ClosedNotice: YouTube music is off on your screen until the next track starts.
FVTK.YouTube.PlayError: YouTube could not play "{title}" (error {code}); the owner may not allow embedding. Pick another track.
FVTK.YouTube.NoKey: Add your YouTube Data API key in Configure Settings → Foundry VTT Toolkit to search. You can still paste links.
FVTK.YouTube.QuotaHint: Each YouTube search uses about 101 of your 10,000 free daily units; a row uses up to {searches}.
FVTK.YouTube.NoResults: No embeddable music videos of a minute or more found; try another search.
FVTK.YouTube.BadLink: That is not a YouTube video link.
FVTK.YouTube.NoPlaylists: Create or import a playlist first.
FVTK.Settings.GeminiKey.Name: Gemini API key (GM, optional)
FVTK.Settings.GeminiKey.Hint: With a key, the YouTube track picker asks Gemini for short searches and real tracks that match each description, then checks them on YouTube. Get one free at aistudio.google.com. Stored only in this browser.
FVTK.Settings.GeminiModel.Name: Music search model
FVTK.Settings.GeminiModel.Hint: Gemini model the YouTube track picker uses to suggest searches and tracks (Build campaign's automatic picks too). gemini-flash-lite-latest is fast and cheap; if the chosen model is busy, the picker tries Flash-Lite once. The list comes from your Gemini key.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiOff: Add a Gemini key in settings for smarter searches.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiError: Gemini did not answer ({message}); used plain searches instead.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiBusy: Gemini is busy ({message}); used plain searches, and skipping Gemini for the rest of this search. Try again in a few minutes.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiSkipped: Gemini skipped (busy earlier in this search); used plain searches.
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.Name: Scene image generator (GM)
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.Hint: Locations and scenes with no matching image get one generated during a NotebookLM import, for you to review before upload; the GM Assistant draws with it too. Pollinations is free with no account (slow, small watermark). Gemini uses your Gemini API key and needs billing on it (a few cents an image). OpenAI uses your OpenAI API key (billed per image) and falls back to Pollinations when a request fails. Paste my own generates nothing: paste images from ChatGPT or any tool into the review window.
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.OpenAI: OpenAI GPT Image (your key, Pollinations as backup)
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.Manual: Paste my own (ChatGPT or any image tool)
FVTK.Settings.GeminiImageModel.Name: Gemini image model
FVTK.Settings.GeminiImageModel.Hint: Gemini model for images when the generator is Gemini, and for the GM Assistant when scene images are off. gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) is the fastest and cheapest; gemini-nano-banana-2.1 or gemini-3-pro-image draw more carefully and cost more. Image models have no free tier: the Gemini API key's project needs billing. The list comes from your Gemini key.
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIKey.Name: OpenAI API key (GM, optional)
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIKey.Hint: For the OpenAI image generator. Create one at platform.openai.com (the account needs credit, and OpenAI may ask you to verify the organization before it makes images). Stored only in this browser.
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIImageModel.Name: OpenAI image model
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIImageModel.Hint: GPT Image model when the generator is OpenAI. gpt-image-2.5-flare is fast and suits scene art; gpt-image-2.5-sunburst draws more carefully. Older models (gpt-image-1.5) work too, at their fixed sizes. The list comes from your OpenAI key.
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIImageQuality.Name: OpenAI image quality
FVTK.Settings.OpenAIImageQuality.Hint: Higher quality takes longer and costs more per image.
FVTK.Settings.ImageStyle.Name: Scene image style
FVTK.Settings.ImageStyle.Hint: Put in front of every image prompt, before the entry's visual: field or description.
FVTK.Settings.ImageAutoApprove.Name: Keep generated images without review
FVTK.Settings.ImageAutoApprove.Hint: Upload every generated scene image and carry on with the import, without waiting for you to approve them.
FVTK.Images.Title: Scene images
FVTK.Images.Hint: Generating with {provider}. Edit a prompt and regenerate anything you don't like, untick what you'd rather leave without a scene, then upload.
FVTK.Images.WillGenerate: {count} scene images will be generated with {provider} for you to review.
FVTK.Images.GeminiCost: Gemini bills each image, regenerations included, to your API key (a few cents each).
FVTK.Images.OpenAICost: OpenAI bills each image, regenerations included, to your API key. If a request fails, Pollinations draws that image instead.
FVTK.Images.Fallback: OpenAI couldn't draw this ({message}), so Pollinations did.
FVTK.Images.HintManual: Paste your own images. For each card: Copy prompt, make the image in ChatGPT (or any image tool), copy the image (right-click, Copy image), then click the card and press Ctrl+V, click Paste, or drop an image file on it. Untick what you would rather leave without a scene, then upload.
FVTK.Images.HintPaste: You can also paste or drop your own image on any card.
FVTK.Images.PasteHere: Paste an image here (Ctrl+V) or drop one
FVTK.Images.CopyPromptHint: Copy a request for this image, ready to paste into ChatGPT or another chat assistant.
FVTK.Images.PasteHint: Use the image on your clipboard for this card.
FVTK.Images.PollinationsHint: Draw this image with Pollinations instead: free, no account, about 45 seconds an image.
FVTK.Images.ViewHint: Click to open full size in its own window.
FVTK.Images.ViewerHelp: Scroll to zoom, drag to move, double-click to fit.
FVTK.Images.ClipboardEmpty: There is no image on the clipboard: right-click the image and choose Copy image first.
FVTK.Images.ClipboardBlocked: The browser did not let the toolkit read the clipboard. Click the card and press Ctrl+V instead.
FVTK.Images.DropFailed: That drop had no image the toolkit could read. Copy the image and paste it, or save it and drop the file.
FVTK.Images.NoCard: Every card already has an image: click a card first to replace its image.
FVTK.Images.WillPaste: {count} scenes need an image: the review window lets you paste one for each.
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeAutoPick.Name: Pick YouTube tracks during import
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeAutoPick.Hint: After a NotebookLM import, fill every imported playlist that has no YouTube tracks yet with the top search result for each track line (about 2 searches, 200 quota units, per line). Change any pick later in the YouTube track picker.
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPicking: Picking YouTube tracks for {count} track lines…
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPickQuota: YouTube's daily search quota ran out; picked so far: {summary}. Run the YouTube track picker tomorrow for the rest.
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPickNoKey: {count} playlists have no YouTube tracks. Add a YouTube Data API key in settings to have them picked during import.
FVTK.Import.CheckIssues: Campaign check: {count} gaps (click to see them and a fix prompt for NotebookLM)
FVTK.Import.CheckMore: …and {count} more (all are in the fix prompt).
FVTK.Import.CheckFix: You can import now and fix later. To fix, paste this into NotebookLM in the same notebook, then build again with its answer: entries with replaces: update what is already there.
FVTK.Import.Copied: Fix prompt copied. Paste it into NotebookLM.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Title: Campaign built
FVTK.Import.Summary.Documents: Documents: {created} created, {updated} updated, {relinked} earlier ones re-linked.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Scenes: Scenes created or updated: {count}, each with hidden NPC tokens, a journal pin and its soundtrack.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Skipped: Skipped or not found: {count} (click for the list)
FVTK.Import.Summary.Issues: Campaign check gaps: {count}. Build again with NotebookLM's fixes to close them.
FVTK.Adventure.Title: Pack the NotebookLM campaign
FVTK.Adventure.Caption: Built from NotebookLM in {world}
FVTK.Adventure.Description: {scenes} scenes, {actors} actors, {items} items, {journal} journals, {playlists} playlists, {tables} rollable tables, {cards} card stacks, {combats} encounters and {folders} folders.
FVTK.Adventure.Hint: Packs everything a Build campaign made, and anything you added to its NotebookLM folders, into one adventure in the world compendium NotebookLM Campaigns, replacing an adventure of the same name. Import it into another world on this server to play the campaign there. Images are not copied: they stay in this world's folder.
FVTK.Adventure.Name: Adventure name
FVTK.Adventure.Nothing: There is no NotebookLM campaign in this world to pack.
FVTK.Import.Empty: Paste NotebookLM's ##ENTRY blocks, or choose the file you collected them in.
FVTK.Import.Counts: {added} new, {replaced} will replace earlier imports, {kept} already imported and kept as they are (tick Replace to update them).
FVTK.Import.Existing.Title: A campaign is already imported
FVTK.Import.Existing.Found: This world already has an imported campaign: {journal} journals, {scenes} scenes, {actors} actors, {items} items, {playlists} playlists, {tables} rollable tables, {cards} card stacks and {combats} encounters.
FVTK.Import.Existing.Packed: The NotebookLM compendiums hold {count} documents from it.
FVTK.Import.Existing.Explain: Clean the world first to start a new campaign: everything the earlier imports made (player characters included) is removed from the world and the NotebookLM compendiums. Or keep it and add these entries to it, for a sequel or more content.
FVTK.Import.Existing.Archive: Archive it first in the NotebookLM Campaigns compendium (as Pack campaign does)
FVTK.Import.Existing.Keep: Keep it and add to it
FVTK.Import.Existing.WillClean: The earlier campaign will be removed from the world and the NotebookLM compendiums before this one is built.
FVTK.Import.Existing.Archived: Archived the earlier campaign as "{name}" in NotebookLM Campaigns.
FVTK.Import.Existing.ArchiveIncomplete: The archive doesn't hold the whole earlier campaign, so nothing was removed and nothing was imported.
FVTK.Import.Existing.ArchiveFailed: Archiving the earlier campaign failed, so nothing was removed and nothing was imported: {message}
FVTK.Import.Existing.Cleaned: Removed the earlier campaign from the world and the NotebookLM compendiums.
FVTK.Images.Finished: Done; {failed} failed. Regenerate them or upload the rest.
FVTK.Images.Slow: Pollinations' free tier makes one image every 45 seconds, so the rest take about {minutes} min.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Kept: Already imported and kept as they were: {count} (build with Replace ticked to update them).
FVTK.Adventure.Clear: Remove the campaign from this world after packing it (to start a new campaign)
FVTK.Adventure.ClearTitle: Remove the campaign from this world?
FVTK.Adventure.ClearConfirm: This deletes {scenes} scenes, {actors} actors, {items} items, {journal} journals, {playlists} playlists and {folders} folders from this world. They are saved in the adventure {name}; Import Adventure there brings them back. Image files are kept.
FVTK.Adventure.ClearIncomplete: The adventure doesn't hold everything in the campaign, so nothing was removed from the world.
FVTK.Adventure.Cleared: The campaign is now only in the adventure {name}. The world is ready for a new Build campaign.
FVTK.Settings.AssistantModel.Name: GM Assistant model
FVTK.Settings.AssistantModel.Hint: Gemini model for the GM Assistant. gemini-flash-lite-latest answers in seconds. Another model (e.g. gemini-flash-latest) gets 30 seconds before the lite model answers instead, and is skipped for 10 minutes after being busy or slow. Combat narration uses it too. The list comes from your Gemini key.
FVTK.Assistant.Title: GM Assistant
FVTK.Assistant.GMOnly: Only a GM can use the GM Assistant.
FVTK.Assistant.NoKey: Add your Gemini API key in Configure Settings → Foundry VTT Toolkit to use the GM Assistant.
FVTK.Assistant.Busy: The GM Assistant is still answering the last question.
FVTK.Assistant.Context: Knows the campaign: {count} documents (about {k}k characters), sent to Gemini with each question.
FVTK.Assistant.Empty: Ask about the campaign ("What does Rook know about the vault?"), for ideas or a quick ruling, or for new content ("Make a fixer NPC for the docks"): entries come with a Build campaign button. Ask for a picture ("Draw a portrait of Rook") or press Image, then save it or use it as a portrait, token or scene background. You can also type /gm and a question in the chat box.
FVTK.Assistant.Placeholder: Ask about the campaign, ask for new NPCs, locations, scenes… or describe a picture and press Image (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
FVTK.Assistant.Speaker: GM Assistant
FVTK.Assistant.SourcesOn: Searches your source library (rulebooks, notes) when answering.
FVTK.Assistant.SourcesOff: Your source library is synced but switched off.
FVTK.Assistant.SourcesNone: No source library yet: add your rulebooks and notes with Sources.
FVTK.Assistant.ImageHint: Draw what the box describes: Gemini writes the prompt from the campaign, then the scene image generator draws it.
FVTK.Assistant.DescribeImage: Describe the picture first, e.g. "Rook at the bar" or "the docks at dawn".
FVTK.Assistant.UploadRefused: the server did not accept the file
FVTK.Assistant.UsePortraitConfirm: Replace {name}'s portrait and token image (its placed tokens too) with this image?
FVTK.Assistant.UseBackgroundConfirm: Replace the background of the scene {name} with this image?
FVTK.Assistant.UsedPortrait: {name} has the new portrait and token image.
FVTK.Sources.Title: GM Assistant sources
FVTK.Sources.Intro: Put the files behind your campaign here: rulebooks, house rules, notes, glossaries, transcripts. Sync uploads them to a Gemini File Search store on your Gemini key, and the GM Assistant searches them when it answers, citing what it used.
FVTK.Sources.NoFolder: The folder doesn't exist yet. Add files creates it.
FVTK.Sources.NotSynced: Nothing is synced to Gemini yet.
FVTK.Sources.UpToDate: Gemini is up to date with the folder.
FVTK.Sources.Hint: PDF, text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, XML and YAML (Word and HTML files too, if you copy them in another way), up to 100 MB each and about 330 MB in all on the free tier. Audio and video aren't searchable: use transcripts. Files and questions go to Google's Gemini API; on the free tier Google may use them to improve its products.
FVTK.Sources.RemoveConfirm: Delete the source library ({count} files) from Gemini? The files in Foundry stay; Sync uploads them again.
FVTK.Sources.Removed: The source library was deleted from Gemini.
FVTK.Sources.NoKey: Add your Gemini API key in Configure Settings → Foundry VTT Toolkit first.
FVTK.Sources.Report: Sources synced: {uploaded} added, {replaced} updated, {removed} removed, {unchanged} unchanged.
FVTK.Import.CheckIssuesOne: Campaign check: 1 gap (click to see it and a fix prompt for NotebookLM)
FVTK.Settings.CombatNarration.Name: Combat narration (GM)
FVTK.Settings.CombatNarration.Hint: Gemini narrates attacks: a miss as soon as the attack is resolved, a hit once damage is rolled, with the NPC's reaction or an NPC attacker's taunt. It reads the recent chat so it follows the fight and doesn't repeat lines. Uses the Gemini API key above, in the active GM's browser.
FVTK.Settings.CombatResolution.Name: Resolve attacks automatically (Cyberpunk RED)
FVTK.Settings.CombatResolution.Hint: When an attack targets someone, compare it with the range DV (from the weapon's DV table and the distance between the tokens) or, in melee, the defender's Evasion: NPCs roll it automatically, player characters are asked to. NPCs with REF 8+ dodge ranged attacks when that's their better chance. The defender wins ties. A card shows the result, with Hit and Miss buttons for the GM.
FVTK.Settings.CombatApplyDamage.Name: Apply damage on a hit (Cyberpunk RED)
FVTK.Settings.CombatApplyDamage.Hint: When damage is rolled for a hit, apply it with the system's own Apply Damage (armor SP, ablation, Critical Injury bonus), so the narration knows how hurt the target is.
FVTK.Narration.Dodged: {name} dodges instead of taking the DV {dv}.
FVTK.Narration.CanDodge: {name} has REF 8+ and may roll Evasion to dodge; the GM can change the result.
FVTK.Narration.NoDistance: The tokens aren't on the scene you're viewing, so the range DV is unknown.
FVTK.Narration.NoDV: Out of range, or the weapon has no DV table.
FVTK.Files.MixedKinds: {file} holds a different kind of document from the other files; import it on its own.
FVTK.Files.NothingToImport: No documents to import from those files.
FVTK.Files.NothingToExport: There is nothing to export here.
FVTK.Files.NoPacks: There is no compendium to use: create an unlocked one first.
FVTK.Files.ImportPackHint: Choose the compendium to add the documents to. The files must hold documents of its kind.
FVTK.Files.ExportPackHint: Choose the compendium to save as a JSON file.
FVTK.Service.geminiHint: Your Gemini API key and the Gemini models for the GM Assistant, YouTube track suggestions and Gemini images.
FVTK.Service.youtubeHint: Your YouTube Data API key, and whether Build campaign picks tracks for its playlists.
FVTK.Service.openaiHint: Your OpenAI API key, and the model and quality for OpenAI scene images.
